name: Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
definition: The **Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension** is the no-clashing teaching dimension when every sample assigned by the teacher mapping is required to contain only positive examples of its target concept.
graph_summary: No-clashing teaching dimension with positive-only teacher samples.
origin_references: The positive no-clashing variant is defined in \cite{KSZ2019}.

monotonic.proof: Restrict a positive no-clashing teacher mapping to a subfamily. Each remaining sample is still positive for its target, and every pair that could clash in the restricted mapping already could clash in the original one.

c_monotonic.proof: Restrict a positive no-clashing teacher mapping to the conditioned fibre and delete fixed coordinates.  Positivity and no-clashing are preserved.
